reason: The cited code for openNodes calls loadGraph(), which reads a local host file via fs.readFile(this.memoryFilePath), parses it, filters entities/relations, and returns the resulting graph in the tool response, so SECRET is supported. There is no arbitrary code execution shown, and no delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported. Although the returned file contents could potentially include user-supplied graph data, the cited lines alone do not establish attacker control over that content, so UNTRUSTED is insufficient.
